newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade slow.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Thursday, but buying interest waned after an active early session, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,440 rupiah. The results of a 10,500-tonne crude palm oil tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan are expected to be announced on Friday.

The traders said a plantation house had tendered parcels of 500 tonnes each for delivery in January, February and March. There were three parcels of 1,000 tonnes each and 2,000 tonnes each for delivery in April, May and June.
Traders said the highest bid for January was 1,091.81 rupiah/kg, excluding tax and transportation costs, February 1,083.63 and March 1,070 rupiah.
The top bid for the 2,000-tonne parcels for all three months was 1,070 rupiah/kg, while that for the 1,000-tonne lots was 1,078.50 rupiah/kg for all three months.
"It's not certain yet if the seller was agreeable to the bids," one trader said.
Data from Belawan Port showed the MT Permorin will leave for Surabaya on Friday with 2,000 tonnes of crude palm oil.
